package audit

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

// MaxPayload bounds one event payload.
const MaxPayload = 8192

// ValidType reports whether an event type is a short printable name.
func ValidType(eventType string) bool {
	if eventType == "" || len(eventType) > 64 || !utf8.ValidString(eventType) {
		return false
	}

	for _, r := range eventType {
		if r <= ' ' || r == 0x7f {
			return false
		}
	}

	return true
}

// ValidPayload reports whether a payload is bounded, well-formed JSON.
func ValidPayload(payload []byte) bool {
	return len(payload) > 0 && len(payload) <= MaxPayload && json.Valid(payload)
}

// EventHash is the content hash recorded with an event and recomputed by
// verification. The type and payload are length framed.
func EventHash(eventType string, payload []byte) string {
	sum := sha256.New()

	_, _ = sum.Write([]byte(eventType))
	_, _ = sum.Write([]byte{0})
	_, _ = sum.Write(payload)

	return hex.EncodeToString(sum.Sum(nil))
}

// ValidAuthEvent admits the event kinds the managed hook records.
func ValidAuthEvent(kind string) bool {
	switch kind {
	case "login", "logout", "oidc_login":
		return true
	}

	return false
}
